description:
[measured] One X (Twitter) post by ID with its text, author and metrics, plus one page of up to 20
    replies and next_cursor for more. Read a thread or the reaction to a post.
    Always paid per call: $0.005 (x402, MPP or 1 prepaid credit); no key's daily allowance covers it.

api_key.description: LiquidVision API key (lv_...). Omit when the key is sent as the X-API-Key header on the connection.
api_key.title: Api Key

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

tweet_id.description: Numeric ID of the post (the digits at the end of its URL).
tweet_id.title: Tweet Id
